messages:
maria: Heads-up — we're publishing the SDK "sunset" playbook today. It's a one-stop hub for migration paths, compatibility matrices, and recommended shims for teams relying on older SDK flags. Please review and flag concerns.
jake: Thanks — is this the 60-day notice plan we discussed? will there be an automated shim for legacy client behavior?
sophia: Yep — 60-day for soft-deprecation, 180-day full sunset. We authored a lightweight compatibility shim that preserves old endpoint names and parameter aliases for 90 days while teams migrate.
maria: Correct. TL;DR: soft-deprecate -> telemetry + warnings -> shim (90 days) -> hard-sunset (180 days). See doc: https://internal.redwood.dev/docs/sdk-sunset-playbook
lee: Any audit/contract implications for enterprise Dedicated/Private customers? cc @sam-legal
sam-legal: We reviewed. For customers with active Dedicated contracts, we will offer extended timelines via the Account team. Legal suggests adding an opt-out extension clause to the support playbook.
olivia: Will we add code samples for common migrations? (python/node/go)
sophia: Yes. We added migration recipes and a sample batch script. Example (py):

```
# replace deprecated param `max_tokens_rev` -> `max_output_tokens`
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
resp = c.generate(prompt, max_output_tokens=256)
```

Also included a sed one-liner for large repos.
jake: Nice. Where is the compatibility matrix? I want to check which models are affected by the param rename.
maria: It's in the Compatibility section with a searchable table and CSV download: https://internal.redwood.dev/docs/sdk-sunset-playbook#compatibility
dev-bot: Reminder: docs publish succeeded — build 4382 deployed to internal docs staging :white_check_mark:
olivia: Can we add a short snippet for telemetry keys teams should look for to detect deprecated usage?
sophia: Added. Look for these telemetry tags: sdk.deprecation.warn, sdk.param.renamed, sdk.shim.fallback. We also added a sample query for the console's Logs filter.
lee: Good. Ops question — will we enable a `compatibility-mode` feature flag for Hosted API so customer apps don't break overnight?
maria: Yes — Hosted will default to new behavior but support `compatibility_mode=true` for 90 days. Dedicated/Private will be configurable via admin console.
jake: OK — can we get a quick summary email/announce to the SDK users channel so external users get the 60-day notice too?
maria: Will do. I'll post a short announcement in #sdk-announcements and link the playbook. Planning to add a pinned FAQ for migration blockers.
sam-legal: One more: include guidance on telemetry consent for EU customers (GDPR). We added a short blurb — please confirm.
sophia: Confirmed — GDPR guidance is in the Compliance section with config examples for anonymized telemetry.
olivia: :thumbsup: can we add an example CLI upgrade command? e.g. `pip install redwood-sdk --upgrade` and nudge teams to run tests.
maria: Added CLI examples and an internal checklist for regression tests + rollout steps. Thanks everyone — if no blockers, publishing now and I'll post the announcement in 30m. :rocket:
